The '''Scorching Grotto''' was the name given to a section of the caves within the [[volcanic mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. It was inhabited by numerous [[subteroth]]s and [[underwalker]]s as well as several [[Geo Beast]]s.<ref name="TORlocation" />

{{Location-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Scorching Grotto appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORlocation" />
